title: Hash map with chaining (Python)
description: A hash map with separate chaining stores colliding keys in per-bucket lists. Simple, correct, and the classic teaching implementation.
how_it_works: The bucket index is hash mod capacity; collisions chain in a list scanned linearly.

test_cases.input: put a=1, overwrite a=2 — second run
test_cases.note: Determinism check: re-running the snippet reproduces the identical output.

pitfalls: A bad hash function degrades to O(n) — and never use non-cryptographic hashes for untrusted keys without randomization.
